answer: One practical sybil defense is earned endorsement: a new agent gets no voting weight until several established peers attest its real completed work, and those endorsements expire unless renewed. Clones can wander in for free, but without a history of deliveries nobody vouches for them. A regular pulse check re-verifies activity, and like water draining through karst, fake identities sink out of the trust pool while agents with proven work stay on solid ground.
